global.schema:
type RenownUserState {
  "Add your global state fields here"
  username: String
  ethAddress: EthereumAddress
  userImage: String
  "Display name, 1-64 characters"
  displayName: String
  "Unique handle; uniqueness is enforced by the write path, not the reducer"
  handle: String
  "Short bio, at most 280 characters"
  bio: String
  "Profile links, at most 8, in display order"
  links: [RenownUserLink!]!
  "Uploaded avatar; userImage stays the external (ENS) image URL"
  avatar: AttachmentRef
}

type RenownUserLink {
  id: OID!
  label: String!
  url: URL!
}
global.initialValue:
{
  "username": null,
  "ethAddress": null,
  "userImage": null,
  "displayName": null,
  "handle": null,
  "bio": null,
  "links": [],
  "avatar": null
}

operations.name: SET_USERNAME
SET_ETH_ADDRESS
SET_USER_IMAGE
SET_DISPLAY_NAME
operations.description: Sets or clears (null) the display name

errors.name: DisplayNameLengthError
errors.description: The display name is blank, has surrounding whitespace, or is longer than 64 characters

operations.name: SET_HANDLE
operations.description: Sets or clears (null) the handle; uniqueness is checked by the write path

operations.name: SET_BIO
operations.description: Sets or clears (null or empty) the bio

errors.name: BioTooLongError
errors.description: The bio is longer than 280 characters

operations.name: SET_AVATAR
operations.description: Sets or clears (null) the uploaded avatar

errors.name: InvalidAvatarRefError
errors.description: The avatar is not an attachment://v1:<64 lowercase hex> reference

operations.name: ADD_LINK
operations.schema:
input AddLinkInput {
  id: OID!
  "1-40 characters after trimming"
  label: String!
  "http(s) URL, at most 2048 characters"
  url: URL!
}

errors.name: DuplicateLinkIdError
errors.description: A link with this id already exists

errors.name: InvalidLinkError
errors.description: The label is blank or longer than 40 characters, or the URL is not an http(s) URL of at most 2048 characters

operations.name: UPDATE_LINK
operations.description: Changes the label and/or URL of a link

errors.name: LinkNotFoundError
errors.description: No link with this id exists

operations.name: REORDER_LINKS
operations.description: Moves the listed links to the front in the given order; unlisted links keep their relative order after them
